summary: Action plugins cannot be listed directly because they appear as their matching modules. Use ansible-doc -l to list modules and ansible-doc <name> for details, which should say if a module has an action plugin.
questions: How do I see which action plugins are installed?
How can I tell whether a module has a corresponding action plugin?
What command lists all available modules?

answer_card.title: Listing action plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
You can't list action plugins directly. They show up as their modules.

- `ansible-doc -l` lists available modules.
- `ansible-doc <name>` shows a module's docs, which should mention any corresponding action plugin.
